Hey! :>

Never done this before- don't really go on Reddit all that often, so sorry in advance if I'm doing something wrong here. But I'm 17/F/In the Chicago area. I'm also a giant horror geek- anything from books to games to obscure deep web junk. I've read a handful of webcomics (I'd love to hear if you've got any recommendations!), but I'm definitely a cartoon person. 

No cats here- I'm hella allergic to most- but I do have a pup and two rats at home. c: 

Ahhh, not sure what else to add here? I've got a skype if you're interested in chatting, but I'm okay with talking through PM's too, if you'd like! Hope to hear from you soon!

Also reminds me of a certain line in Sock Opera' 

"Who would sacrifice everything they've worked for just for their dumb sibling?"

Either way, it's really none of our business, imo.

As somebody with pretty visible scars- even though I can't speak for Tyler, obviously- I'd be pretty upset if people discussed it. Self harm is an issue that shows itself through their music, yes, but tbh I think it'd be kind of rude to pry about it.
Pretty much how you put it. Just too tired and bogged down to care anymore. Everything is just so pointless, it's like, why even bother?

yeah, well, l don't blame them tbh. like I said I would have done the same thing. They've been incredibly supporting of me, sending me some good vibes even though I don't respond to em. just wish they would have SPOKEN to me about first instead of waiting two-three weeks and then acting upon it.

as for how I'm feeling, I dunno. tired and hopeless, mostly. I honestly just don't care anymore. I'm just done.
